summary: The reimagining of Dark Yugi's Duelist Kingdom deck: Black Luster Soldier and Magician of Black Chaos return as a dual-purpose Ritual series. One Ritual Spell summons either boss monster and keeps recurring itself, while Mind Shuffle loops resources between the two. Grindy control/midrange with the most developed combo lines of any new CORI archetype so far.
sourceNote: Card text below was updated 2026-07-08 via live web search (WebFetch to Yugipedia, YGOPRODeck, and Konami's own official database all returned HTTP 403 — blocked before any page content could be retrieved, so none of this was cross-checked against a primary source directly). An initial pass mis-typed Mind Shuffle as a Quick-Play Spell; the user corrected it to a Continuous Trap, which prompted a second full re-verification pass across all 6 cards (2026-07-08, later same day). On that second pass, 2 of 3 independent search results agreed on Skull Archfiend of Chaos at ATK 2500/DEF 1200 (one citing product listing CORI-EN002), so its stats were updated from this file's original 2650/2450 placeholder; Griffoh's stats (DARK/Fiend/Effect, Level 1, ATK 300/DEF 200) were filled in the same way. Magician of Dark Chaos – Black Chaos's effect changed materially from the original draft (no shuffle-into-Deck alt-summon found; instead a GY Spell recovery + on-summon banish effect), and Black Luster Soldier gained a previously-missing on-Special-Summon banish effect. Treat every field here as best-effort and paraphrased (not verbatim Konami wording) rather than confirmed — verify against Konami's official card database before finalizing a tournament deck list.

cards.name: Ritual of Light and Darkness
cards.effectText: Ritual Summons “Magician of Dark Chaos – Black Chaos” or “Black Luster Soldier – Soldier of Light and Darkness” by tributing monsters and/or banishing from your GY to meet the Ritual Summon's Level requirement. Once per turn, add this card plus 1 other card that mentions “Light and Darkness Ritual” from your GY to your hand.

cards.name: Black Luster Soldier – Soldier of Light and Darkness
cards.effectText: Must first be Ritual Summoned. Cannot be destroyed by battle. Unaffected by your opponent's activated effects unless they target this card. Once per turn each: if this card is Special Summoned, you can target 1 card your opponent controls and banish it; if this card destroys a monster by battle, it gains 1500 ATK and can make a second attack in the same Battle Phase.

cards.name: Magician of Dark Chaos – Black Chaos
cards.effectText: Must first be Ritual Summoned. Unaffected by your opponent's activated effects unless they target this card. Your Spells/Traps cannot be destroyed or banished by your opponent's card effects. Once per turn each: if this card is Special Summoned, you can add 1 Spell from your GY to your hand; you can also target 1 card your opponent controls and banish it face-down.

cards.name: Skull Archfiend of Chaos
cards.effectText: If this card is in your hand or GY: you can place 3 other cards from either GY and/or face-up banishment on the bottom of the Deck in any order — at least 1 must mention “Light and Darkness Ritual” — to Special Summon this card. If this card is sent to the GY: send a Ritual Spell from your hand or Deck to the GY, then add the Ritual Monster it mentions from your Deck to your hand. Each effect once per turn.

cards.name: Mind Shuffle
cards.effectText: Continuous Trap. Once per turn, during either player's turn: add 1 monster that mentions “Light and Darkness Ritual” from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card. Also (not in the same Chain as the above): when your opponent activates a card or effect, you can return 1 Level 7 or higher monster you control to the hand and Special Summon 1 monster that mentions “Light and Darkness Ritual” from your hand, with a different name than the returned monster, ignoring its Summoning conditions.

cards.name: Griffoh
cards.effectText: (Quick Effect) Discard this card, then either: reduce the next battle or effect damage you'd take this turn to 0; or Set 1 Quick-Play Spell/Trap that mentions “Light and Darkness Ritual” from your Deck and treat it as able to be activated this turn (this is how it lets Mind Shuffle — a Continuous Trap — be Set and activated the same turn, sidestepping the normal restriction on newly-Set Trap Cards). Once per turn. Can also be used as the entire Tribute cost for Ritually Summoning exactly 1 Level 8 Ritual Monster whose effect requires tributing monsters.

comboLines.title: Mind Shuffle grind loop
comboLines.body: Send Skull Archfiend of Chaos to the GY to send Ritual of Light and Darkness to the GY and tutor a Ritual Monster, then use Mind Shuffle (a Continuous Trap) to recur pieces and Ritual Summon. Set Griffoh to enable Mind Shuffle to be Set and activated the same turn. Swap between Black Luster Soldier – Soldier of Light and Darkness (offense, battle-destruction snowball, plus an on-Special-Summon banish) and Magician of Dark Chaos – Black Chaos (protection/banish, plus GY Spell recovery on Special Summon) depending on board state. Documented in early web coverage as the deck's core engine; see sourceNote — treat exact wording as best-effort, not confirmed.

sampleDecklist.label: Community-documented list with a real combo engine (Mind Shuffle loop) — more developed than most other new CORI archetypes, but still not a tournament Top Cut list.
